// why: Each recommendation exists to surface a gate in the editor instead of only in CI.
Personal preferences do not belong here: .gitignore tracks this file and ignores
the rest of .vscode, so settings stay yours.
// dbaeumer.vscode-eslint: Shows FR-B6 boundary violations inline as you type, rather than at npm run lint or in a failed CI run. This is the gate contributors hit most often.
// Prisma.prisma: Syntax and validation for prisma/schema.prisma, where the anonymity invariant is structural (FR-C2, FR-C6, FR-C18 to FR-C20). Catches an invalid schema before the gate does.
// vitest.explorer: Runs the two architecture gates from the editor. Useful because their failure messages name the requirement they enforce.
// ms-vscode-remote.remote-wsl: The project lives in the Linux filesystem on purpose: 134 times faster than the Windows mount, measured. A contributor on Windows needs this to open it correctly.
